result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major layout problem with misaligned cards in a horizontal carousel and a minor styling inconsistency with image badges.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' section, the restaurant cards are vertically misaligned. The images appear to have different heights, causing the restaurant titles, delivery fees, and time badges to be staggered rather than aligned on a consistent baseline.
issues.suggestion: Set a fixed height or consistent aspect ratio for all card images in the carousel. Use a flex or grid layout to ensure the text content below the images aligns perfectly across all cards.

issues.description: The delivery time badges on the restaurant images are inconsistent. 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccol...' use a solid white background with black text, while 'Smash Bros Burgers' uses a translucent dark background with white text.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the visual style of the time badges across all cards to maintain a cohesive design.
